modules.title: Getting Set Up
modules.content:
## Baseball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App

### Download and Install

Open the Apple App Store on your device by clicking the App Store icon.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000564845-01.jpg)

Then search for the Synergy Sports Mobile app using the search bar.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Downloading and Installing the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000564845-02.jpg)

Once you find the Synergy Sports Mobile app, click on the install button to download the app to your device.

> Note: You may be prompted by the App Store to enter your Apple ID. This is the username and password you use to install apps and make changes to your iPad. This username and password is not affiliated with Synergy Sports Technology.

### Direct Links for App Install:

**App Store (Apple):**<https://apps.apple.com/us/app/synergy-sports-mobile/id6462990172>

**Play Store (Android):**<https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sportradar.coaching.mobile>

this article (see the “Getting Set Up” lesson)

## Baseball Mobile App: Minimum Requirements

### Hardware

- iPhone
  - iPhone 11 or later, with the exception of iPhone 13 Mini
- iPad
  - 8th or later
- iPad mini
  - All models

### iOS

- iOS 13.4

### Android

- Android 8.1 (27 api level)

### Hard Drive Space

There are no requirements for the amount of hard drive space necessary for the application. However, hard drive space is required to download video for offline playback. The amount of space needed is determined by the number of videos being downloaded.

### Internet Bandwidth

We recommend a sustained bandwidth of at least 3.5 Mbps for uninterrupted streaming of Synergy video.

this article (see the “Getting Set Up” lesson)

## Baseball Mobile App: Logging in to the App

### Logging In

Select the Synergy Sports Mobile App icon on your iPad

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565555-01.png)

Enter your Synergy Username and Password and then press the **Login** button.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565555-02.jpg)

####

If it is your first time logging in you may be asked to upload a Profile Photo. You can choose to upload a Profile Photo or skip this step.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565555-03.jpg)

Then you will be directed to the **Dashboard** of the Mobile App.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Logging in to the App](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565555-04.jpg)

## Baseball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard

After you log into the Synergy Mobile App, you will land on the Dashboard. The Dashboard will display a **Edits**button as well as your Recent Items and Favorites.

###

### Edits Button

The **Edits** button will direct users to the edits that they have created, received, and/or sent.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565556-01.jpg)

### Recent Items and Favorites

Favorites and Recent Items will be listed at the bottom of the Dashboard page.

- **Recent Items:** The video clips you have recently watched
- **Favorites:** Videos that you have marked as a "Favorite"

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565556-02.jpg)

####

#### Marking Favorite Videos

To mark a video as a "Favorite" you can click the heart icon next to any video in the app. To unmark the video, you can click on the heart icon again.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Navigating the Dashboard](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565556-03.jpg)

## Baseball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings

The Main Menu and User Settings allow users to quickly navigate around the mobile app, and update profile information and download settings. This is also where users can find the Log Out button.

###

### Main Menu and User Settings

Clicking the hamburger icon in the upper left corner will reveal the Main Menu and the User Settings, which are accessible from every page in the App.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565557-01.jpg)

####

#### Main Menu

The Main menu allows you to navigate to Edits when you are not on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565557-02.jpg)

####

#### User Settings

The User Settings are where you will find **Settings**, **Storage**, **Logout**, and **Nightmode**.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565557-03.jpg)

#####

##### Settings

Clicking on**Settings**will allow you to access Profile Settings (name and picture), Download Settings, Onboarding information, and the option to go Offline. To learn more about how to manage downloads and Download Settings, you can read **Manage Videos for Offline Playback**.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565557-04.jpg)

#####

##### Storage

**Storage** will tell you how much storage you have left in the Mobile App. If you click on **Storage**in the User Settings, you can delete downloads.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Main Menu and User Settings](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565557-05.jpg)

modules.title: Games View
modules.content:
## Overview

The Games View in the Synergy Mobile App allows users to view Synergy logged games or Team Logger Games clip by clip, directly on your mobile device.

## Selecting a Game

When you open the Mobile App, the new Dashboard now has the Games Tab on the left. You also have a list of recently viewed items below, allowing quick access for easy review.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-01.jpg)

When you select the **Games** tab, the team your account is associated with populates the game list from newest game to oldest.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-02.jpg)

From here, you can use the Games Filters button to refine your list or use the search bar to find a specific game to view. With filters you can sort by **League**, **Season**, **Game Types**, **Divisions**, **Conferences**, and **Teams**.

Filters can also be saved after creation, by pressing the **Save icon** at the top right of the screen and renaming the filter as you desire.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-03.jpg)

Once saved, it will be added to your list of saved filters, which you can access by pressing the **Saved** toggle at the top of the screen.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-04.jpg)

The starred filter in your saved list will be your default filter when opening the Games tab. You can set a different saved filter as your default by pressing **the triple dot button** to the right of the saved filter, then press **Set Default**. From here, you can also remove the filter from your Saved list by pressing **Delete**.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-05.jpg)

You also have the ability to switch your data source between **Synergy,****My Team,**and****My Team (All)**** to view games and practices that have been logged by you in the Synergy Team Logger or shared with your team from other organizations, just like in the Synergy Baseball desktop app.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-06.jpg)
![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-07.jpg)

## Games View

Once you have selected your game, the name and date are listed at the top of the screen with the final score listed below. You will see the video player, as well as a list of all of the event clips listed below.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-08.jpg)

Above the video player on the left there is a dropdown menu that allows you to switch between any recorded camera angles associated with the game selected.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-09.jpg)

You can scroll through the list of clips below the video player, which are organized by innings and at bats. Each event is separated by a light grey line and each at bat is separated by a brighter white line.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-10.jpg)

You can also jump to a specific inning of your choice by selecting the **three line Hamburger** menu at the top left of the events list.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-11.jpg)

## Filtering

By selecting the filter icon on the right above the video player, you can further filter your playlist by selecting **Pitcher**, **Hitter**, **Fielder**, **Baserunner**, or **Catcher** for either team.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-12.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-13.jpg)

You can select a single player or multiple players. You can further refine each player, by pressing the **chevron** icon to the right of their name.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-14.jpg)

This will bring up a list of all at bats for that player. You can deselect any at bats you do not wish to view. Once you return to the game screen, only your filtered results will be displayed in the events list.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-15.jpg)

> Note: There is also a toggle at the top of the screen to Display Pickoff Attempts. This is turned off by default.

## Video Player Controls

The video player controls are hidden by default to allow for better viewing. In order to display the controls, tap the video player anywhere away from the center of the player. This is by design, so when you are viewing clips, you can pause any clip by tapping the center of the screen.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-16.jpg)

You can play or pause, jump from clip to clip, adjust your viewing settings, mute audio, or enter full screen display.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-17.jpg)

> Note: You can also enter fullscreen (landscape) by rotating your device.

With the Timeline bar, you also have the ability, while paused, to select the precise moment you wish to view by pressing your thumb on the dot and sliding left or right.

## Frame By Frame Viewing

While the video is paused, you can advance or reverse the timeline, one frame at a time by simply double-tapping on the right side of the screen to advance or the left side of the screen to reverse, allowing for easy pinpointing of any specific moment of the clip you wish to review.

## Landscape Mode

In landscape mode, the event playlist is hidden to allow better viewing of your video. However, it can be easily viewed by selecting the list icon next to the settings icon for easier navigation.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-18.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Games View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000578273-19.jpg)

modules.title: Watching Edits and Offline Playback
modules.content:
## Baseball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits

The most important feature of the Synergy Mobile App is the ability to watch Custom Edits and Source Edits on the go. The layout for watching edits will slightly differ depending on whether you are a Player or a Coach.

###

### Custom Edits and Source Edits

To get to Custom Edits and Source Edits, click the **Edit** button on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565558-01.jpg)

#### Player View

The Edit page for players will have the following options:  My Edits, Received Edits, Completed Edits, All Edits

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565558-02.jpg)

- **My Edits**: Any custom edits you have created or saved
- **Received Edits**: Edits that have been sent to you by your coaches and staff members
- **Completed Edits**: Edits that you have received and completely finished watching
- **All Edits**: "My Edits" and "Received Edits"

#### Coach View

The Edit page for coaches will have the following options:  My Edits, Sent Edits, and Source Edits.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565558-03.jpg)

- **My Edits:** Any custom edits you have created or saved
- **Sent Edits**: Edits you have sent to your team.
- **Source Edits**: Source Edits/Timeline Edits that are associated with your team
- **All Edits**: "My Edits" and "Source Edits”

### Watch Edits

On the Edits page, search for the name of the edit that you wish to watch. You can use the search bar or scroll through the lists.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565558-04.jpg)

Click on the name of an edit to open that edit in the video player.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Watch Custom Edits and Source Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565558-05.jpg)

## Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback

Downloading videos in the Synergy Mobile App will allow you to watch videos offline, which can be very useful if you are traveling without access to the internet.

###

### Downloading Videos

Navigate to the edit you wish to download, and then select the **download icon**. A progress bar will appear around the download icon to let you know your video is downloading.

###

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-01.jpg)

### Offline Playback

Once a download is complete, the download icon will change to a checkmark. Videos that have this checkmark will be viewable offline.

###

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-02.jpg)

### Download Settings

The Download Settings allow you to set the download video quality, data usage preference, and delete downloads. To get to the Download Settings, click the menu icon in the upper left corner.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-03.jpg)

Then select Settings.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-04.jpg)

Next, click on Download Settings.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-05.jpg)

After you select Download Settings, you will be able to set the video quality for your downloads. You may also use the toggle to select or deselect Wifi-Only downloads. If you do not select wifi-only, your downloads may use data.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-06.jpg)

To delete downloads from the Mobile App, click on**Manage Downloads** in the Download Settings. From here, you can choose to Delete All or select individual downloads to delete.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Manage Videos for Offline Playback](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565559-07.jpg)

modules.title: Creating and Sending Edits
modules.content:
## Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers

The Synergy Mobile App can be used to send edits and see who has viewed the edits you have sent. Below are the instructions for sending edits and monitoring viewers.

### Send Edits

Navigate to your edits by clicking on the **Edits** icon on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-01.jpg)

Find the edit that you wish to send.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-02.jpg)

After you select an edit, you will see two tabs:**Clips in Edit** and **Distribution Lis**t. Click on **Distribution List**.

> Note: If you are on a tablet, you may need to hold your device vertically for these tabs to appear.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-03.jpg)

After you select the **Distribution List** tab, you will see a**Share** button.

> Note: If you have already sent this clip, you will need to select the Share icon (*see below*).

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-04.jpg)

Click on the Share button, and then select whether you wish to share with Synergy Users or Create a URL:

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-05.jpg)

- The **Synergy Users** option will include the members of your team. Select which users you want to share your edit with, and then click Send.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-06.jpg)

- **Create a URL** option will allow you to send a link to Synergy users outside of the Mobile App. You can elect to send the link via Airdrop, iMessage, email, etc.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-07.jpg)

If you need to send a clip that was already shared, you can click the **Share icon** to send the clip to additional recipients.

####

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-08.jpg)

####

#### Monitor Viewers

Once an edit has been sent, you can use the**Distribution List** tab to see who has viewed the edit and how many clips they have watched.

> Note: Only Synergy recipients will be listed in the Distribution List. See the instructions above if you do not know how to navigate to the Distribution List tab.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-09.jpg)

If you click on the name of the recipient, you will get a Clips Breakdown of which clips they have viewed.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Send Edits and Monitor Viewers](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565560-10.jpg)

this article (see the “Creating and Sending Edits” lesson)

## Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits

In the Synergy Mobile App, players and coaches can compile clips from different edits to make a New Edit. Below are the instructions for creating a new edit.

### Create New Edits

Navigate to the Edits icon on the Dashboard.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-01.jpg)

On the Edits page, click the **New Edit** button.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-02.jpg)

Give your New Edit a name and click **Save**.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-03.jpg)

Select an Edit with clips that you wish to add to your New Edit.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-04.jpg)

After you select an Edit, you will see a list of clips. Press and hold down on a clip to select or deselect that clip. A red bar will appear if you have selected a clip.

> Note: If you are on a tablet, you may need to hold your device vertically to complete these tasks.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-05.jpg)

Once your selections are made, click on the **Clips Selected** button.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-06.jpg)

Then select Add to Edits.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-07.jpg)

From here, you can select the New Edit that you created, and then click the **Add to Edit** button. This will add the selected clips to your New Edit.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-08.jpg)

Your New Edit and the added clips will be available under the **My Edits** tab.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Create New Edits](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000565561-09.jpg)

modules.title: Game Logger
modules.content:
## **Getting Started with Mobile Logger**

**Prerequisite:** You must have access to and utilize the Team Logger desktop application. The mobile logger functions as an extension of the desktop version.

**Internet Connection:** A stable internet connection is required for all logging activities on the Mobile App.

**Accessing the Logger:**

- From the main application screen, tap the **Logger**tile located under Games and Edit.
- Alternatively, tap the **Logger**button in the bottom right corner of your screen.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-01.jpg)

**Game Synchronization:**

- Upon accessing the Mobile Logger, a chronological list of your games (newest to oldest) will display. This list directly mirrors your games in the desktop application.
- All changes made in the Team Logger (desktop) will automatically synchronize with the Mobile Logger, and vice versa.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-02.jpg)

> **Note**: Games **must be created in the Team Logger desktop application** to appear in the Mobile Logger. Currently, game creation is not supported within the Mobile Logger app.

### **Filtering and Searching Games**

To efficiently locate a specific game within your list:

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-03.jpg)

**Search Bar:** Use the **search bar** at the top of the games list to quickly find games by name or other keywords.

**Filters:**

Tap the **Filters**button in the upper right corner of the games list screen.

The following filter options are available:

- League
- Seasons
- Game Types
- Teams
- Opponents

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-04.jpg)

After selecting each filter, tap the **Back chevron**button (<) to apply it.

Once all desired filters are applied, tap the **Back chevron**button again to return to the games list.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-05.jpg)

Only games matching your selected criteria will be displayed.

### **Logging a Game: Interface and Navigation**

Once you've selected a game to log, you'll see the logging interface.

####

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-06.jpg)

#### **Layout Overview**

**Settings Menu:** Tap the **gear icon**(⚙️) in the upper right corner to access settings. Here you can adjust:

- **Pitch Location Perspective:** Changes how the strike zone is displayed.
- **Pitch Velocity Measurements:** Switches between units (MPH or KPH).

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-07.jpg)

**Game Status Display:**At the top of the screen, you'll see the teams, scores, current inning, and count.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-08.jpg)

**Adjusting Game Status:** Tap this display to open the **Game Status menu**, allowing you to manually adjust the current inning or count.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-09.jpg)

**Player Information (Pitcher & Hitter):**

Buttons displaying the current pitcher and hitter (with their names and numbers) are shown below the game state.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-10.jpg)

**Substitutions:** Tap either player button to open a screen with the current lineup (left) and full roster (right). Select the player in the lineup you wish to substitute, then select the player from the roster you wish to replace them with. Tap **Apply**to save changes.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-11.jpg)

> **Note:** Players currently in the lineup will have a **green checkmark** next to their name in the roster list.

**Lineup Navigation:** Below the hitter button, the lineup order is displayed with twoarrows. Use these arrows to quickly cycle through the lineup to the correct hitter.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-12.jpg)

**Handedness:**

- The handedness (R for Right, L for Left) of both the pitcher and hitter is displayed.
- **Changing Handedness:** Tap the corresponding letter (R or L) to switch handedness. A confirmation prompt will appear asking if you want to make the change to the current At-Bat.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-13.jpg)

**Event Editing:**

Tap the **pencil icon** in the upper right (next to the settings button) to access the event list for the current game.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-14.jpg)

**Jump to Inning:** In the upper left of the event list, tap the **hamburger menu** (☰) to select a specific inning to jump to.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-15.jpg)

**Edit an Event:** Locate the event you wish to edit and tap on it. This will re-open the logging workflow, allowing you to make any necessary adjustments.

**Field View:** Below all the controls, the Field view displays players in their positions, providing a visual representation of the game.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-16.jpg)

### **Creating an Event (Pitch)**

All logged events are time-stamped.

1. Tap the **New Pitch**button in the lower left corner of the screen.
2. A red dot and a stopwatch will appear, indicating that the event timer has started.
3. To end the event, tap the **Pitch**button again. The timer will stop, and the event will be time-stamped.
4. Once time-stamped, you can proceed to tag the event with detailed data.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-17.jpg)

### **Tagging an Event:**

After creating an event, you can tag it with various data points using nine distinct menus. You are not required to add data to every menu; you can swipe through them to access the desired tagging options.

### **Event Menu**

Select the primary outcome of the pitch:

- Ball
- Strike Taken
- Strike Swing
- Foul
- In Play
- Pickoff Attempt (Pitcher): 1B, 2B, 3B
- Pickoff Attempt (Catcher): 1B, 2B, 3B
- Catcher Block
- Catcher Throw
- Auto Ball
- Auto Strike
- Balk

####

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-18.jpg)

###

### **Type Menu**

Categorize the pitch type:

- Fastball
- Curveball
- Slider
- Changeup
- Cutter
- Splitter
- Knuckler
- Sinker
- 4-Seam FB
- 2-Seam FB
- Screwball
- Forkball
- Knuckle Curve
- Eephus
- Slurve
- Sweeper
- Pitchout
- Int'l Ball
- Unknown

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-19.jpg)

###

### **Location Menu**

- Displays the strike zone and current pitch perspective (adjustable in settings).
- Tap the desired pitch location on the chart to tag it. You can change the location by tapping a different spot.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-20.jpg)

###

### **Velocity Menu**

- Defaults to MPH (adjustable in settings).
- Select a velocity from the displayed chart or tap the grey box to manually enter the pitch velocity.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-21.jpg)

###

### **Result Menu**

Record the outcome of the plate appearance or specific play:

- Strikeout
- Walk
- Intentional Walk
- Hit By Pitch
- Catcher Interference
- Batter Interference
- Strikeout Safe WP (Wild Pitch)
- Strikeout Safe PB (Passed Ball)
- Hitter Out Of Box
- Check Swing
- Broken Bat

**Swing Type:**

- Full Swing
- Excuse Me Swing
- Slap Swing
- Fake Bunt Swing
- Runner Protection
- Standard Bunt Swing

**Bunt Type:**

- Bunt Sacrifice
- Bunt Hit
- Bunt Suicide Squeeze
- Bunt Drag
- Bunt Push

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-22.jpg)

###

### **BIP (Batted Ball In Play) Menu**

**BIP Type:**

- Ground Ball
- Line Drive
- Fly Ball
- Popup
- Flare

**BIP Result:**

- Out
- Single
- Double
- Triple
- Home Run
- Error
- FC Out (Fielder's Choice Out)
- FC Safe (Fielder's Choice Safe)
- SAC Bunt (Sacrifice Bunt)
- SAC Fly (Sacrifice Fly)
- Double Play
- Triple Play
- Infield Fly Rule
- GR Double (Ground Rule Double)
- HR Inside the Park (Inside the Park Home Run)

**Hit Quality:**

- H (Hard)
- M (Medium)
- S (Soft)
- VS (Very Soft)
- Bunt (Specific tag for bunts)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-23.jpg)

### **Spray Chart Menu**

- #### Tap the hit location on the displayed field to tag the BIP's landing spot.
- To change the location, simply tap a different desired spot on the chart.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-24.jpg)

### **Field Menu**

Detail fielding actions and errors:

**Fielder Sequence:** Tap the buttons for the order in which fielders handled the ball. The sequence will appear on the table above the field display, where you can add or remove players.

**Error:**

1. Select the player from the sequence table.
2. Select the error type from the list:
   - Field
   - Throw
   - Receive

**Interference:**

- Fielder
- Fan

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-25.jpg)

### **Runner Menu**

This menu allows you to track runner movement and RBIs:

**Base Display:** Shows which bases are currently occupied by runners.

**RBIs:** To the right of the base display, you can enter the number of RBIs for the play.

**Runner Movement List:** Below, a list of runners will display, showing their starting base, ending base, and how they advanced.

**Advance Reason:**Tap the **How**field for a runner to select an Advance Reason, such as:

- Adv, on the Throw (Advanced on the Throw)
- Error
- Balk
- Defensive Interference
- Stretch Safe
- Runner Going
- Delayed Steal

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Game Logger](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000585661-26.jpg)

modules.title: Multi-Game View
modules.content:
The Multi-Game view allows you to dive deep into player performance across multiple games, seasons, and teams. This powerful tool puts detailed player insights right at your fingertips.

Follow these steps to get started:

### **Access Multi-Game View**

From your app's Home Screen, tap the **Multi-Game**icon to enter Multi-Game view.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-01.jpg)

### **Select Your Data Source**

Tap the **Synergy**Iconto choose your preferred data source

- **Synergy:** Comprehensive data from our Synergy platform.
- **My Team:** Focus on your data tagged from the Synergy Logger.
- **My Team (All):** Focus on your data, as well as any Shared Games from the Synergy Logger

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-02.jpg)
![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-03.jpg)

### **Choose Player Type**

Select the role of the player you wish to analyze:

- **Pitcher**
- **Hitter**
- **Fielder**
- **Runner**
- **Catcher**

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-04.jpg)

### **Select Your Player**

Use the **Search Bar** or the available Filters (**League**, **Season**, **Team**, **Player**) to pinpoint the specific player you're interested in.

Once you've made your player selection, tap **Apply**.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-05.jpg)

### **Player History**

After selecting a player, their history will be displayed. Here, you can select specific teams and seasons to include in your analysis.

To clear your player selection and return to the player selection page, tap the **X**button located above the player history.

The **Refresh**button will deselect all currently chosen team and season selections, while keeping your selected player.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-06.jpg)

### **Select Event Types**

Tap the **Event Types**iconin the upper right, below the Play icon, to bring up a list of event types. You can make multiple selections

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-07.jpg)

- Pitch
- Pickoff
- Balk
- Challenge
- Interruption of Play
- Other

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-08.jpg)

### **Refine Your Search with Filters**

Once your player, seasons, and teams are selected, use the extensive filter options to narrow down your results even further. These include:

- Players
- Left/Right (handedness)
- Games
- Innings
- Runners On Base
- Outs
- Count
- Pitch Type/Velocity (Range filter)
- Pitch Result
- BIP Type
- BIP Result
- BIP Hardness
- Non-BIP Result
- Baserunner Movement
- Bunts

When utilizing the Pitch Type/Velocity Filter, you can first choose a specific pitch type, then use the **range filter** to precisely define the velocity range for your search results.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-09.jpg)

### **Removing Applied Filters**

To remove any filter selection, tap the **x** located to the right of the applied filter.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-10.jpg)

### **View Video Playback**

Once all your desired filters are in place, tap the **Play**icon in the upper-right corner of the screen. This will display the video player, with your filtered events organized in a playlist below the video.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-11.jpg)

### **Adjust Clip Settings**

Tap the**Gear**icon to adjust the clip**Duration** and **Time Before Pitch** for your video playback.

###

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-12.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-13.jpg)

### **Accessing Alternate Angles**

Above the video player, tap the **drop-down**button to select and view any available alternate camera angles for the event.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-14.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-15.jpg)

### **Sending Clips to Edits**

Use the **right-pointing arrow** located above the playlist to send the currently playing clip to an existing edit, or to create a new edit and add the clip to it.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-16.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Multi-Game View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000591561-17.jpg)

modules.title: Practice and Sim Game Logging
modules.content:
## Baseball Mobile App: Practice View

The Mobile Practice View is where you can view your practices. Unlike Games, Practices do not have to be completed in order to view them in the Mobile App.

Tap the **Practice** tile on the **Home** screen or select **More** (bottom right), then select **Practice**from the menu.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597226-01.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597226-02.jpg)

A list of your existing practices will display. You can use the **Filter** button to sort the practices by **League**, **Season**, **Team**, **Player**, and **Practice Type**. You can also use the search field to locate sessions by team or player.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Practice View](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597226-03.jpg)

Practice Types include **Sim Game**, **Batting Practice**, **Bullpen**, and Training/Workout. Tap any session to review the practice data and associated video.

Within a practice you can:

- Open an individual practice session, and review logged data and associated video
- Adjust clip lengths
- Choose from multiple camera angles
- For Batting Practice sessions, filter by hitter group or individual player
- Return to the practice list without leaving Practice View

## Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging

Sim Game provides full game-style logging with additional options suited for practice scenarios, such as same-team scrimmages, Coach or Machine assigned pitching, and placement of Ghost Runners. All Sim Game sessions created on desktop can be viewed in the mobile app, and all Sim Game sessions created in the mobile app can be viewed on desktop.

It is important to note that you should only be logging from one device at a time.

####

#### **Creating a Sim Game**

To create a new Sim Game session, navigate to the**Logger** page and use the pill button to toggle to **Practices**. This will display your existing practice sessions. Tap the **+ New Practice** button to create a new session.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-01.jpg)

Select the**Date** and **League**, then choose **Sim Game** as the **Practice Type**.

Select the Home and Away teams. The same team may be selected for both sides. Indicate whether the session is a Doubleheader. Tap **Save** to continue to the Lineups and Rosters screen.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-02.jpg)

Set your team lineups on the Lineups screen. You can switch between home and away teams using the team's name buttons at the top. Tap players from the roster to add them to the lineup.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-03.jpg)

You can add any additional or missing players to the roster using the**Player Search** tool to browse for players already in the Synergy system. If the player does not already exist in our system, you can create a Player ID **Add Player+** button. Players can be duplicated and assigned to both teams' rosters and lineups. Unlike Game logging, identical players may exist on both teams simultaneously. Add or remove lineup spots with the **+** and **–**buttons.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-04.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-05.jpg)

You may assign defensive positions using the dropdown next to the players name in the lineup (not required in Sim Game mode). Pitcher options include**Player**, **Coach**, or**Machine**. Once lineups are complete, tap **Apply**.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-06.jpg)

Note: If the lineup is incomplete, a warning appears but does not prevent creation of the session.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-07.jpg)

#### **Logging Events**

Sim Game logging follows the same workflow as a regular game. Tap **New Pitch** at the bottom of the screen to begin a timestamp. A rolling clock and recording indicator appear. Tap the button again to end the timestamp.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-08.jpg)

Available data fields include:

- **Event**- Tag event type

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-09.jpg)

- **Type**- Tag the Pitch Type

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-10.jpg)

- ****Location**** - Tag the Pitch Location

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-11.jpg)

- ****Velocity**** - Tag the Pitch Velocity

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-12.jpg)

- ****Result**** - Tag Non-BIP Result

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-13.jpg)

- ****BIP**** - Tag BIP Result

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-14.jpg)

- ****Spray**** - Tag the Hit Location with the Spray Chart

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-15.jpg)

- ****Field**** - Tag Defensive Fielding sequence.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-16.jpg)

- ****Run**** - Add, remove, or advance runners to any base

**
![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-17.jpg)**

#### **Ghost Runners**

On the Run tab, tap the display to add runners to any base. Both lineup players and Ghost Runners may be used.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-18.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-19.jpg)

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Sim Game Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597227-20.jpg)

Ghost Runners allow you to create desired scenarios like starting with runners on base, build situational practice scenarios and practice specific game situations.

When you have finished tagging data for the event, tap **Apply** to save your entry.

#### **Reviewing Your Session**

Once you have logged events in your Sim Game session, the logged practice data can be retrieved in Practice view with your other existing practices. In order to add video to your practice session, you will need to complete the process by uploading and synching your video and events in the desktop Synergy Logger.

modules.title: Batting Practice and Bullpen Logging
modules.content:
## Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging

Batting Practice is designed as a simplified, hitter-focused logging workflow with support for multiple batting groups.

#### **Creating a Batting Practice Session**

To create a new Batting Practice session, navigate to the**Logger** page and use the pill button to toggle to **Practices**. This will display your existing practice sessions. Tap the **+ New Practice** button to create a new session.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-01.jpg)

Select the **Date,** **League**, choose **Batting Practice**as the **Practice Type**, then select your **Team**. Once your selections have been made, tap **Save** in the upper right to create the new batting practice.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-02.jpg)

Set your team lineups on the Lineups screen. You can create multiple hitter groups by tapping the **+** icon above the lineup. Select your desired group and tap players from the roster to add them to the group lineup.

You can add any additional or missing players to the roster using the Player Search tool or the **Add Player+** button. Players may appear in more than one group within the same session, and you can add an unlimited number of hitters to any group.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-03.jpg)

Select the **Pitcher** cell and assign a **Player**, **Coach**, or **Machine** as the pitcher by tapping the name on the roster. Tap **Apply** to proceed to the logging screen.

#### **Logging**

The primary focus of logging a Batting Practice is rapid clip creation. The current group is shown in the upper left, with hitters listed to the right. Switch groups using the Group dropdown. Change the active hitter by tapping the player’s tile or the Hitter box.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-04.jpg)

To log the BP, tap **Mark Swing/Take a single time** to create a timestamp. This timestamp will apply a default 3 second lead and lag, generating a 6 second clip. After marking, you may:

- Enter data for the swing
- Remove the timestamp with the **Remove Swing/Take** button
- Tap **Mark Swing/Take** again for the next pitch (timestamp only)
- Tap **Apply** to save the pitch with your logged data

> Note: It is okay to wait, and press apply to cover multiple pitches. Pitches are assumed to be saved unless removed, or if Apply is not pressed before leaving the session.

The following data fields are available for logging Batting Practice:

- **Event** - Tag Swing Result, BIP Type and BIP Hardness.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-05.jpg)

- **Spray** - Tag hit location on the Spray Chart

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-06.jpg)

- **Type** - Tag the Pitch Type

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-07.jpg)

- **Loc** - Tag the Pitch Location

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-08.jpg)

- **Velo** - Record the Pitch Velocity

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Batting Practice Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597228-09.jpg)

Tap **Apply** to save you entry.

#### **Reviewing Your Session**

Once you have logged events in your Batting Practice session, the logged practice data can be retrieved in Practice view with your other existing practices. In order to add video to your practice session, you will need to complete the process by uploading and synching your video and events in the desktop Synergy Logger.

## Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging

Bullpen sessions differ from Sim Game sessions because they focus on pitcher development rather than game situations. Bullpen removes game concepts such as Line Score, Batter, Fielders and Home/Away teams. Instead, it emphasizes Strike Zone, Pitch Location and Pitch Execution.

#### **Creating a Bullpen Session**

To create a new Bullpen session, navigate to the **Logger** page and use the pill button to toggle to **Practices**. This will display your existing practice sessions. Tap the **+ New Practice** button to create a new session.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-01.jpg)

Select the **Date**, **League**, choose **Bullpen** for the**Practice Type** and select your **Team**. When your entry is complete, tap **Save** to create the Bullpen session

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-02.jpg)

Set your pitching order on the **Order** screen. Tap a player from the roster on the right to add them to the pitching order. You can add any additional or missing players to the roster using the Player Search tool or the **Add Player+** button. Once your order has been set, tap **Apply** to save.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-03.jpg)

#### **Logging Pitches**

The pitching order is displayed along the top of the screen. Tap a name to change the active pitcher. To log a pitch, tap **Mark Pitch Release a single time** to create a timestamp. This timestamp will apply a default 3 second lead and lag, generating a 6 second clip.

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-04.jpg)

 After marking, you may:

- Enter data for the Pitch
- Remove the timestamp with the **Remove Pitch Release** button
- Tap **Mark Pitch Release** again for the next pitch (timestamp only)
- Tap **Apply** to save the pitch with your logged data

Pitch data options include:

- **Pitch Type**- Tag the Pitch Type

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-05.jpg)

- **Location**- Tag **Pitch Location**, set an **Intended Pitch Zone**, **Pitch Execution** (**Success** or **Miss**)
- Individual Pitch Zone can be selected by using a long press on the Intended Pitch Zone

![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-06.jpg)

- **Velocity**- Tag the**Pitch Velocity**

**
![Screenshot: Baseball Mobile App: Bullpen Logging](https://pregame-academy.vickerydigital.com/assets/synergy/77000597229-07.jpg)**

Note: From all three of the Bullpen logging screens, you can add a **Hitter** by selecting the **L** for left-handed hitter or **R** for right-handed hitter in the upper right. This will display a silhouette of a batter on the Location grid. You can also tag if the pitch was a **Wind Up** or a **Stretch**.

> Note:**Hitter**, **Wind Up** and **Stretch** sustain from pitch to pitch, and must be manually turned off to remove.
